properties.name: jodconverter.remote.ssl.key-alias
properties.description: Alias that identifies the key in the key store.

properties.name: jodconverter.remote.ssl.key-password
properties.description: Password used to access the key in the key store.

properties.name: jodconverter.remote.ssl.key-store
properties.description: Path to the key store that holds the SSL certificate (typically a jks file).

properties.name: jodconverter.remote.ssl.key-store-password
properties.description: Password used to access the key store.

properties.name: jodconverter.remote.ssl.trust-store
properties.description: Trust store that holds SSL certificates.

properties.name: jodconverter.remote.ssl.trust-store-password
properties.description: Password used to access the trust store.

properties.name: jodconverter.remote.ssl.trust-all
properties.description: Indicates if all certificates are trusted (certificate validation becomes disabled).

properties.name: jodconverter.remote.ssl.verify-hostname
properties.description: Enable hostname verification during SSL handshake.
